scope: All 1012 focus-telemetry requests read as raw body; values retained only as safe labels, markers or hashes.
limits: Telemetry is diagnostic, not authoritative business response evidence.
Messages/stacks and user text omitted; hashes point to raw source item for private review.
Reported HTTP failures may be sampled or duplicated; a telemetry row is not an extra captured exchange.
No native runtime root cause can be inferred solely from these event names.
